title: RowChanged
description: Result: the Database Adapter's CDC read path (Design.md §13 Step J5, Decision #15) tails the MySQL binlog for the orders table and publishes every row change — bus-originated (via the write path) OR a direct SQL write bypassing the bus entirely. Deliberately a DIFFERENT subject from events.orders.OrderCreated (the write path's own input), so the adapter never subscribes to its own CDC output as a write-path trigger. Carries NO correlationId — unlike events.orders.OrderPersisted, this isn't replying to any specific request (Decision #26).

operation.description: Which binlog row-event type produced this — WriteRowsEvent/UpdateRowsEvent/DeleteRowsEvent respectively.

table.description: The table name (always "orders" today — the only table this adapter watches, infra/mysql/init.sql).

row.description: insert/delete: the row's values. update: the row's values AFTER the change.

previousRow.description: Only present for operation="update" — the row's values BEFORE the change.
